name: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B
description: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B is a 9 billion parameter model that can generate images from text descriptions and supports multi-reference editing capabilities.

examples.name: Surreal Underwater Garden
examples.description: Bioluminescent flora in a cosmic scene

input.prompt: A surreal underwater or cosmic garden scene with bioluminescent flora

code_snippets.label: cURL
code_snippets.code:
curl https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/run/flux-2-klein-9b \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {API_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
      "prompt": "A surreal underwater or cosmic garden scene with bioluminescent flora",
      "go_fast": true,
      "output_megapixels": "1",
      "aspect_ratio": "1:1",
      "output_format": "jpg",
      "output_quality": 95
    }'

code_snippets.label: JavaScript
Python
code_snippets.code:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/run/flux-2-klein-9b",
    headers={
        "Authorization": "Bearer {API_TOKEN}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    },
    json={
        "prompt": "A surreal underwater or cosmic garden scene with bioluminescent flora",
        "go_fast": True,
        "output_megapixels": "1",
        "aspect_ratio": "1:1",
        "output_format": "jpg",
        "output_quality": 95
    }
)

result = response.json()
print(result)
